project2.title: Dualing Driver
project2.description: Dualing Driver is an arcade-style multiplayer shooter focused on fast pacing and bullet control. The project emphasizes responsive movement, combat readability, and map flow balancing in short matches.

project5.title: Auto Robot
project5.description: Auto Robot is a small RTS-inspired survival game where players route a robot to collect coins, avoid threats, and optimize decisions under pressure.

project7.title: There Are No Flowers
project7.description: There Are No Flowers is a tabletop naval combat design project based on historical maritime conflict. The work centers on turn structure, strategic choices, and collaborative balancing across playtests.

project8.title: U Are Fired
project8.description: U Are Fired is a game jam project created under tight time constraints. It demonstrates quick scoping, mechanic prioritization, and fast iteration for a playable final build.

project9.title: Double Dresden
project9.description: Double Dresden is a point-and-click mystery puzzle experience. Players investigate scenes, combine clues, and progress through narrative-driven logic challenges.

hero.description: 我专注于制作有挑战性、富有启发性的互动体验。目前在 RIT 学习游戏设计与开发。

project2.title: 斗杀驾驶员
project2.description: 《斗杀驾驶员》是一款街机风格的多人射击游戏，专注于快节奏和子弹控制。项目强调响应式移动、战斗可读性和短对局中的地图流平衡。

project5.title: 自动机器人
project5.description: 《自动机器人》是一款小型的RTS启发式生存游戏，玩家路由机器人收集硬币、躲避威胁并在压力下优化决策。

project7.title: 没有花的地方
project7.description: 《没有花的地方》是一个基于历史海战的桌面战斗设计项目。工作重点是回合结构、战略选择和整个游戏测试中的协作平衡。

project8.title: 你被开除了
project8.description: 《你被开除了》是在紧张时间限制下创建的游戏jam项目。它展示了快速范围界定、机制优先级划分和用于可玩最终版本的快速迭代。

project9.title: 双重德累斯顿
project9.description: 《双重德累斯顿》是一款点击式谜题冒险游戏。玩家调查场景、组合线索，并通过叙事驱动的逻辑挑战取得进展。
